jobs.title: LSG Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Recruitment 2026 Apply Online for
jobs.shortInfo: Local Self Government Department, Rajasthan has released Safai Karamchari Contractual Recruitment Notification 2026. Those candidates who are Interested in this Rajasthan Safai Karamchari Contractual Recruitment 2026 can Apply Online from 15/08/2026 to 28/09/2026. Read the notification for recruitment eligibility, post information, selection procedure, Practice Test, pay scale and all other information

applicationFee.paymentMode: Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / Online

vacancyDetails.eligibility: The applicant must be a domicile of the State of Rajasthan. No educational qualification has been prescribed for the contractual post of Safai Karamchari. More Eligibility Details Read the Notification

Step 6 : After that the candidate has to enter his mobile number
Step 7 : An OTP will be received on the mobile number given by the student, he will have to enter it
Step 8 : DigiLocker Account Confirmation process will be completed
